faqs.q: My property currently has no active stays. Can I still list it on rental sites while I wait for my permit?
faqs.a: No. The Short Term Rental Ordiance (3-1-5-3(R)(1) requires you to have an active STR permit and business license before you create or activate a listing. Merely offering the property for rent even with a "blocked" calendar can be considered an illegal advertisement and may result in enforcement action.
